answers.evidence:
Live fixture (`127.0.0.1:18999`) verified directly: `/health` → 200 `{"status":"healthy","version":"1.0.0"}` (RFC3339 timestamp), `/status` → 200 `errors.total=0, recovery_success_rate=1`, `/metrics` → 200 Prometheus text with **288** `kobayashi_*` series, no stub markers in any body.

| Scenario | Result |
|---|---|
| **Live fixture 18999** | ✅ **10/10 PASS**, exit 0 — ×5 consecutive full runs, plus 3 earlier runs (2 had the transient) |
| **501 stub fixture** (controlled, `:18998`) | ❌ 6/10 FAIL, exit 1 — P08 dumps `501 Not Implemented: stub route`; P09 flags `POST /health → 501 (want 405)` |
| **Dead port** (`:18997`) | ❌ 9/10 FAIL, exit 1 — connection refused surfaces on every probe |
| Toolchain | `gofmt` clean, `go vet ./...` clean, `go build` clean (go 1.26) |

Edge cases tested: transient-vs-persistent stub marker (observed the real flake once; confirm-retry clears it, persistence still fails with line-level diagnostics), content-type enforcement, timestamp staleness window, 405-vs-501 on wrong method, 404-vs-501 on unknown routes, and env-overridable base URL for controlled negative tests.
